title: The join funnel's first screen fits in one view and has no double cards, overlapping badge or boxed logo

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'):'';const k=r('app/themes/frequency/kit-site.css'),fx=r('components/frequency/site/shell/site-fx.tsx'),i=r('app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx'),w=r('components/frequency/site/pages/funnel/induction-welcome.tsx');const bad=[];if(/\\] \\.block\\{/.test(k)||!fx.includes('div.block'))bad.push('the kit .block card rule still hits Tailwind block (the double-card glitch)');if(!w.includes('iw-card')||!i.includes('InductionWelcome'))bad.push('the first beat is not the compact kit screen');if(i.includes('fixed inset-x-0 top-3 z-50')&&!i.includes('preview && !fq'))bad.push('the Preview badge still overlaps the header');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1277: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Owner 2026-10-22: all funnel pages need a serious rework. Cause of the double cards: the site kit's .block card rule (and the FX card-light query) matched Tailwind's block utility, boxing every block label and span under the site shell; both now match div.block only. Under the Frequency design the induction drops its own wordmark and Welcome pill (the site header carries them), draws beat 0 as one two-column kit screen (promise left, choices, Decide later and email right) that fits above the fold at 1280x800 and 390x844, shows the Preview note in flow instead of fixed over the header, and gives beats 2 to 4 the kit form dress and smaller headings. The /join beta card's button glow is no longer clipped. The stray typo 'sapce' is stored operator copy in the Default Funnel editor, not code. 2026-10-22 follow-up: with seven first-question cards (six doors plus Just here to belong) the last card spans both columns so the grid has no orphan.
